reason: AFG is a risk-bearing specialty commercial P&C insurer. It earns underwriting premiums and investment income, and it sells through independent agents and brokers. Goosehead is a personal-lines insurance agency and franchisor. It earns carrier commissions and franchise royalties and fees, and it sells home and auto policies to individual consumers. The two share only the broad P&C insurance label. Goosehead is closer to a distribution channel that AFG might use than to a competitor.
